manualObservations: Sol recovered GAP certification in qualityEvidence, which Flash omitted.
Sol mapped the AI selection explanation to productionProcess, where Flash used qualityEvidence.
Sol mapped the taste tagline correctly and omitted the extra photo-derived product name seen in Flash.
Sol preserved the leading bullet in size/storage text, causing exact-match misses even when sentence content was otherwise present.
Sol retained OCR glyph errors and one summary/taste misclassification; the snack-use suggestion remains omitted.
Sol also returned a source-supported delivery fragment outside the gold annotations; not every non-match is a hallucination.
interpretation: Sol improved several omissions/classifications, but exact-match precision fell and recall was unchanged relative to Flash. Whitespace-only diagnostics improved modestly. This does not justify changing the default from Flash on this evidence.
limitations: All inputs were OCR/native-PDF text; this does not evaluate Sol or Gemini direct vision/OCR capabilities.
Prompt requires verbatim preservation of evidence wording; OCR errors propagate to extracted values.
Single run per model on twelve reused development cases from three source URLs; not an independent holdout.
Strict tuple matching penalizes punctuation, bullet markers, grouping and spacing. Semantic accuracy was not measured.
Quality threshold remains unmet; no new synthetic run or real-farmer acceptance for Sol.
